properties.title: Hazardous Operations
properties.body:
NAVAREA XIX 139/26

A research rocket will be launched from Andøya Space between 30 November and 12 December 2026, daily from 1700 to 2300 UTC.

Maritime traffic is requested to be aware of the following danger areas:

Danger area inner is bounded by the following positions:
A: 69°38.0'N 014°41.0'E
B: 69°36.0'N 015°12.0'E
C: 69°42.0'N 015°43.0'E
D: 69°58.0'N 015°50.0'E
E: 70°12.0'N 015°34.0'E
F: 70°22.0'N 015°00.0'E
G: 70°24.0'N 014°14.0'E
H: 70°07.0'N 013°48.0'E
I: 69°50.0'N 014°05.0'E

Danger area sea is bounded by the following positions:
A: 69°21.0'N 015°51.0'E
B: 69°17.0'N 015°58.0'E
C: 69°18.0'N 016°04.0'E
D: 69°22.0'N 016°00.0'E

For coordination, contact Andøya by phone: +47 940 75 944 / +47 761 44 582 or on VHF channel 16 or 14.

Daily updates are available at www.andoyaspace.no.
